summary.text: Heaven-Human Sensation is a killer move Star Constellation Immortal Venerable created. It allows a Gu Immortal's will to interact and fuse with heaven's will.

claims.text: Qin Ding Ling passes Heavenly Court’s heaven path research results to Qi Sea Ancestor as an information path Immortal Gu. Fang Yuan looks into them and sees two killer moves, this one and human executing heaven’s work. Human executing heaven’s work is built on the foundation of heaven-human sensation. Precisely because of these two killer moves, Star Constellation’s will could interfere and affect heaven’s will, and could even replace heaven’s will to control fate Gu. Fang Yuan acutely senses that these two killer moves are the key to breaking out of his predicament. Following them are concepts Star Constellation Immortal Venerable came up with. Fang Yuan looks at them and gains deep enlightenment: his will represents heaven’s will, heaven’s will represents his will.

Fang Yuan sits in Dragon Palace modifying the two killer moves. He lacks more than half of the Gu worms they need. Immortal Gu are unique, the moves are newly obtained, and modification is difficult. After attempting it for some time he gives up on the Immortal Gu level and targets the aspect of a mortal killer move. He gathers the relevant mortal Gu worms from treasure yellow heaven. After modifying the move from an immortal killer move to a mortal killer move, the difficulty becomes nearly nonexistent. With the two mortal killer moves he stops the formation in the sovereign immortal aperture that had been using qi tides to cleanse the nine heavens and five regions. Heaven’s will is produced. He sends a portion of his will towards it, then activates heaven-human sensation and fuses into the heaven’s will. After he activates human executing heaven’s work, he senses a group of heaven path dao marks.

Fang Yuan’s main body is deep inside Dragon Palace, researching Heavenly Court’s heaven path research results while fighting against time. He activates the immortal killer move Heaven-human Sensation, then human executing heaven’s work. Within the sovereign immortal aperture his will mixes with heaven’s will, and he senses various heaven path dao marks. He then activates unrestrained heavenly mark, expends rank eight immortal essence rapidly, and quickly refines three heaven path dao marks.

To refine heaven path dao marks he has to mingle with heaven’s will and use both heaven-human sensation and human executing heaven’s work to capture their location, then use unrestrained heavenly mark to refine them. Heaven’s will is necessary for that process. If he used heaven’s will dissipation and got rid of heaven’s will, he would also be unable to refine those dao marks.

During Shi Zong’s grand tribulation Fang Yuan stands outside the blessed land’s entrance. He cannot go in. He activates the immortal killer move Heaven-Human Sensation, then human executing heaven’s work, then unrestrained heavenly mark. From outside the entrance he refines all the heaven path dao marks from the grand tribulation.
